name: object_relocation
definition: Pick up and move one or more objects to a specified destination without changing their state.

name: clean_object
definition: Wash, rinse, or otherwise clean one or more objects and put them at a specified destination if needed.

name: heat_object
definition: Heat, cook, warm, or microwave one or more objects and put them at a specified destination if needed.

name: cool_object
definition: Cool, chill, or refrigerate one or more objects in the fridge and put them at a specified destination if needed.

name: fill_container
definition: Fill a container with water and put it at a specified destination if needed.

name: use_lamp
definition: Toggle or use a lamp/light, optionally while holding or examining an object under the light.
